user.title: Connect an ESI R2D7 controller
user.description: Select the AUX-2 RS-232 proxy port. Commands use 9600 8N1. Setup only checks that the port opens; it cannot confirm a controller is attached. IMPORTANT: Stop on any channel stops ALL moving blinds in that R2D7 system; the controller has no per-blind stop. A separate 'Stop ALL blinds' button is added for each system.

error.invalid_channel_range: First channel must not exceed last channel
error.cannot_connect: Could not open this serial port. Check that AUX-2 is online and the port is unused.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already used by an ESI R2D7 entry
